MtPyre_2F_Text_MemoriesOfSkitty: Memories of my darling SKITTY… My eyes overflow thinking about it.
MtPyre_2F_Text_TumbledFromFloorAbove:
Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the ground here and there.
I didn't notice and took a tumble from the floor above.
MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkIntro: Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON? You came along after me! You're rude!
MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkDefeat: Ayieeeeh! I'm sorry, forgive me, please!
MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkPostBattle: People don't come here often, so I thought there'd be rare POKéMON.
MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro:
LUKE: We're here on a dare.
Heheh, if I show her how cool I am, she'll fall for me. I know it!
I know! I'll cream you and show her how cool I am!
MtPyre_2F_Text_LukePostBattle: LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay! I'm right here by your side. We'll make it through this dare!
MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeNotEnoughMons:
LUKE: If you want to take me on, bring some more POKéMON.
If you don't, I won't be able to show off to my girl how cool I am!
MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro:
DEZ: I came here on a dare with my boyfriend.
It's really scary, but I'm with my boyfriend. It's okay.
I know! I'll get my boyfriend to look cool by beating you!
MtPyre_2F_Text_DezPostBattle: DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't care if we lose!
MtPyre_2F_Text_DezNotEnoughMons:
DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you should bring at least two POKéMON.
My boyfriend's strong. Just one POKéMON won't do at all.
MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahIntro: You are an unfamiliar sight… Depart before anything befalls you!
MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahPostBattle:
Our family has been TRAINERS here since my great-grandmother's time…
It is my duty to protect this mountain…
MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderPostBattle:
I get freaked out every time I see anything move…
I shouldn't have come here to train…
